scheduler_adapter_boundary.reason: Kimi WebBridge created a non-active hidden tab. Chromium paused/throttled requestAnimationFrame, so the unadapted active run could not naturally reach its timer terminal within the bounded audit window.
scheduler_adapter_boundary.replacement: Only requestAnimationFrame scheduling was replaced in-page. The compact stepper invoked queued application callbacks with 50ms timestamps; the wide terminal run used MessageChannel callbacks with 50ms timestamps.
scheduler_adapter_boundary.claim_limit: The terminal proof establishes the application's source-defined state transition under a deterministic browser harness. It does not establish background-tab wall-clock timing or trusted native input.

console_observations: Kimi WebBridge exposes no direct console-log command. Error/warn methods plus window error and unhandledrejection were instrumented after load for the exercised runs.
The instrumented wide terminal and compact start/active/terminal sequences recorded zero warning, error, window-error, or unhandled-rejection entries.
No claim is made about console messages emitted before the hooks were installed.
